headline: Coinbase (COIN) Stock May Be Overvalued Following Everything Exchange Expansion Plans
summary: Coinbase Global stock now trades around US$146 after a 67.5% gain over the past three years, yet its valuation checks lean expensive rather than cheap given the recent share price slide and weak shorter term returns. The 67.5% return over three years highlights that longer term holders are still in the green, even though the stock is down sharply over the past year. headline: COIN Q2 Deep Dive: Revenue Miss, Exec Turnover, and Product Diversification Take Center Stage
summary: Blockchain infrastructure company Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 18.5% year on year to $1.22 billion. Its non-GAAP loss of $1.36 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
